smbsp-234.notes: Exact English SM234 Pikachu Cosmos, PSA 9 cert 130809725, 1140x1880 source. Replaced inadequate 322x450 stock reference. Reviewed whole source against clean TCGL master, complete boundaries and 4x native-coordinate tiles. Largest white disc behind the right leaf is 45 pixels across and stays one filled feature; both clipped top-edge discs and the faint lower-right blue disc were restored manually. Printed sunlight, foliage, leaf highlights and yellow grass sparkles excluded. Small circular source candidates explicitly reviewed; unresolved subpixel grain omitted. SIFT registration uses 415 print-anchor inliers with 0.576-pixel median error. Original coverage, protection, roughness and front remain unchanged. Other physical copies differ; this scan does not establish angular calibration.

add.notes: Clipped left-edge disc is complete in motif coordinates; source foil coverage clips it at composition.

smbsp-243.notes: Exact Regigigas SM243 TAG TEAM Powers Collection physical scan, 1080x1510. Reviewed full physical source, paired clean TCGL master, numbered boundaries and native-coordinate foil tiles. SIFT print-anchor registration reviewed at frame, subject and rules. Explicitly retain independently visible round features, including the 35.6-pixel-diameter upper-left disc and smaller lower-right discs. Enlarge and recenter the clipped left-edge disc; reject duplicate fragments and printed snow, rock facets, foliage and mist. Fine unresolved grain and ambiguous tiny sparkles omitted. Original front, TCGL foil, protection and roughness retained byte-for-byte. No relief or changed Cosmos optics. Flat scanning does not calibrate angular response or physical depth; this is visible placement on the selected copy.

add.notes: One complete disc behind the neck; supplied protection clips its printed occlusion.
Observed broken curved swirl perimeter; no invented circular replacement.

neo3-1.notes: Reviewed the complete 600x825 first-edition master and a 3x foil-window enlargement. Explicitly selected measurable circle candidates; replaced large perimeters, crossed features and the broken left swirl. Rejected tiny unresolved grain, angular fragments without a reliable perimeter, and all unselected candidates. Smooth print and supplied SAM protection are unchanged. Identity registration, no crop, offset or flip. The master is the physical-copy source; flat scanning does not establish angular optical calibration, and unresolved faint features remain omitted.

smalt-2.notes: Whole reference/window review: retained visible background spots; excluded toe and foreground leaf-edge candidates. Completed the large upper pale oval and left green and partly occluded orange disks as single filled features; no satellites inside those features. Fine unresolved JPEG specks omitted.

smalt-3.notes: Reviewed all background gaps between wings and printed leaves. Rejected leaf/vein candidates. Completed clipped left oval and green disks to the right of the body and behind the lower-right leaf; protection remains composed separately.

smalt-8.notes: Whole foil window reviewed, including upper edge and gaps below tail/legs. The stone wall and ledge are print, so their lighting patches and grain were excluded; retained independently visible small foil dots and the isolated large right disk. Restored the partially clipped upper pale-blue dot.

smalt-9.notes: Whole window reviewed around every limb, evolution inset and the lower rail. The upper-left pale circle, faint upper-right circle and large lower yellow disk are each single features; their internal glints are replaced by filled geometry. Rock/ray print and subject edges excluded during proposal comparison.

smalt-13.notes: Reviewed whole window against exact print, including flipper gaps and narrow foil beside feet. Omitted foreground rocks and foam candidates; large clipped upper disk and left lower turquoise disk remain single filled features.

smalt-14.notes: Reviewed every gap around the printed bubble crown, tail and wave edge. Printed bubbles and wave rings are distinct from foil spots; rejected contour fragments and retained the isolated large blue disk above the crown.

smalt-18.notes: Reviewed narrow background islands around the mouth, arm and upper evolution inset. Removed floor/rail and printed branch-edge hits; restored the pale left disk and clipped right orange feature.

smalt-19.notes: Reviewed upper background, corners and all subject-edge gaps. Foreground splashes/rocks are print; rejected those candidates. Restored the large upper-right green circle as one disk and the visible lower green foil dot.

smalt-20.notes: Reviewed all sky foil and narrow tail/body gaps. Foreground grass/flowers are print, not dot placement. Completed large left turquoise and faint central pale circles; leaf-shaped sky details were not promoted to dots.

smalt-21.notes: Reviewed entire submerged background and gaps around fins/teeth. Removed mouth/foam and foreground seaweed candidates, preserving the print. Restored partly occluded blue spheres behind the nose and fin as complete disks.

smalt-22.notes: Reviewed dark upper/corner foil and both sides of the hair silhouette. Removed large floor/rock-light false circles and foreground print; retained visible background disks and faint brown circle behind the upper head.

smalt-24.notes: Whole-window Eevee reference review: purple/blue disks are physical foil, while white pointed stars and grass are printed artwork. Completed the three large upper disks and the lower-right moon-like circle as single features, removed crown-edge fragments, and omitted grass/grain candidates.

smalt-25.notes: Compared entire window to printed master again: orange/yellow floating flowers and lower-left flower cluster are printed, removed all four false manual additions. Retained measured blue/pale sky disks and isolated foil specks; dense flowers omitted.

smalt-30.notes: Reviewed the complete snowy illustration and narrow tail gap. Removed smaller printed Sandshrew, fir branches and snowy ground hits. Completed the partially clipped left pale circle and large blue circle behind the tail; snowflake/paint dots remain print.

smalt-31.notes: Whole-window review around the head, tail curls and bottom rail. Snowfall artwork and foot/tail contour hits excluded. Restored the large upper cyan disk behind the hair and the clipped lower-right purple disk as single features.

smalt-32.notes: Reviewed left and right dark foil islands, printed lightning and floating stones. Removed stone/bolt and lower foot-edge hits; retained the observed isolated purple upper-right circle and separate blue small foil dots.

smalt-34.notes: Reviewed factory pipes and each narrow foil island. Rejected foreground waste/pipe and rail hits. Completed faint pale upper-left foil circle; retained independent pale background dots, including the clipped upper-right spots.

smalt-54.notes: Reviewed sky/background against clean Charmander print. Flame/sparks, grass, rocks and foot-edge hits were rejected; retained independently visible foil dots in the sky and sparse dark background.

smalt-59.notes: Reviewed all dark background gaps around Gyarados and the moving-water artwork. Removed body-edge/foam-grain clusters; kept the large purple right disk intact and completed the partially clipped pale lower-left disk.

smalt-61.notes: Reviewed full window, Raichu/Sprite print edges, rain and the small left subject. Retained isolated foil disks and faint small dots; removed wave, rain streak and body contour artifacts. Large yellow disk behind the hand remains a single complete feature.

smalt-68.notes: Reviewed sky, fern edges and foreground fabric/leaf gaps. Foliage and fabric were excluded; completed large faint sky and clipped lower-corner foil disks, retaining the green partially occluded lower-right sphere.

smalt-71.notes: Reviewed foil through the digital background and all gaps around appendages. Rejected circuit/ray details and tail-edge artifacts; retained isolated round foil features, including left and right white disks.

smalt-73.notes: Whole icy-cave window reviewed. Ice/ray print does not define dots. Kept measurable round isolated foil and restored the large upper-left cyan spot; distant defocused ice highlights remain unregistered.

smalt-78.notes: Reviewed rock print and dark background, including the lower rail and hand gaps. Completed the brown/orange oval behind the right leg and lower pink dot, replacing fragment candidates. Rock holes and illuminated stone faces are print.

smalt-83.notes: Reviewed human figure, metallic subject and rail individually against the reference. Kept physical background spheres, including clipped edge spots; removed human/rail/floor candidates and retained independent bottom-ring foil disks.

smalt-86.notes: Reviewed every narrow background gap. Explosive white/blue rays and energy flashes are print; rejected them as dots. Kept round purple/cyan background foil independently.

smalt-98.notes: Final comparison to clean master removed false neck highlight addition. Retained measured isolated cyan/pale background disks, excluding hair, limb, leaf and neck print.

smalt-109.notes: Exact English photo registered to the master and reviewed over the full window. Energy/flame and cloud-print highlights rejected. Kept isolated cyan/pale physical foil disks and measurable small dark-background dots; right-bottom large white disk remains one continuous feature.

smalt-112.notes: Compared whole physical scan with unchanged clean front: orange leaves are printed, pale/yellow circles are foil. Rejected all large leaf-shaped false disks and most vegetation texture; retained isolated pale spheres and explicitly measurable small foil.

smalt-114.notes: Compared whole water scene with the exact clean front. Printed bubbles, waves and coral are distinct from newly visible Cosmos disks. Rejected coral/body-edge candidates and completed faint upper-right and right-mid disks.

smalt-130.notes: Final comparison to clean master removed printed lower green ring. Two physical pointed starbursts traced as observed outlines; measured background disks retained; foliage/glare fragments excluded.

smalt-134.notes: Reviewed all forest foil, the ear gaps and lower leg gap. Rejected foliage/glare clusters. Restored the reddish upper swirl as its observed open curved path, and the green upper burst as a traced pointed shape; colored disks remain whole.

smalt-148.notes: Whole water window reviewed. Printed foam and body-edge candidates were removed. Restored the large upper-right pink sphere as one filled disk, replacing its streak/fragment highlights; retained isolated upper background foil.

smalt-149.notes: Whole window reviewed across each wave, curl and limb gap. Printed wave froth and tail/body edge fragments removed; the two prominent left cyan disks remain intact and isolated upper/right foil circles are retained.

smalt-172.notes: Whole background and limb/evolution/text edges reviewed. Printed lightning and shield/tail edges rejected. Completed broad top brown disk, lower cyan sphere and clipped purple lower spot; no glint fragments inside these large features.

smalt-182.notes: Reviewed complete cave window and every wing gap. Retained isolated pale disks and small background dots, excluding rock/wing highlights and scan grain. Lower-left large disk completed as one circle.

smalt-185.notes: Whole multicolored vortex reviewed. Rocks, spikes and vortex rays were rejected. Retained only isolated round physical foil, completing the lower-right yellow disk; upper pale disk preserved intact.

smalt-186.notes: Whole window reviewed against printed attack rays, body silhouette and floor. Ray/floor candidates omitted. Restored the yellow lower-left circle as a full feature including its dim inner phase; kept independent sky disks.

smalt-189.notes: Selected the exact unstamped Cosmos printing, not the store-stamped version. Whole window reviewed; retained sparse round background foil and removed ground/foliage print hits. No secondary/etched response added.

smalt-190.notes: Reviewed narrow background around every plate/limb. Wave foam and armored print excluded; kept sparse golden/pale Cosmos spheres and distinct small background dots.

smalt-192.notes: Compared entire sky/rock window to clean master. Excluded printed cloud contours and merged two faint large blue disks in wing gap and lower-right sky.

smalt-193.notes: Compared entire foil window to clean master. Removed printed beam/ribbon glints, individual rubble and skirt highlights. Restored large pale pink disk behind upper-left ribbon.

smalt-194.notes: Compared every background area with clean master. Large transparent bubbles, crescents, stars and patterned lower-right bokeh are printed and excluded. Kept separate blue/purple Cosmos disks and measurable isolated foil specks.

smalt-195.notes: Compared source to clean master around tail, wing, belly and all corners. Excluded printed motion ribbon and wing highlight; preserved sparse green-window dots and right-side pale disk.

smbsp-6.notes: Compared whole sky and ground to clean master. Restored complete disks behind tail/ear and right edge; suppressed internal satellites. Removed pebble/debris edges and measured visible foil dots separately.

smbsp-7.notes: Reviewed entire sky, wing gaps and grass against clean master. Completed three large sky/wing disks and lower pale ring as filled whole feature; excluded grass, small airborne dirt and printed contours.

smbsp-8.notes: Whole foil window compared with master: trees, light rays and airborne leaves excluded. Restored missed blue disk above right ear and complete orange left-bottom disk. Large yellow right sphere preserved as one filled feature.

smbsp-9.notes: Compared whole foil to clean master. Large upper-right lens flare and lower flower centers are printed; excluded these and dense foliage. Restored clipped blue disk above subject; retained separate sky dots and a sparse lower gap.

smbsp-15.notes: Compared entire small background gaps to clean master. Removed rocky lava, printed energy and hexagonal glints; sparse left-edge Cosmos disk completed as one filled disk.

smbsp-22.notes: Entire green/yellow window compared to printed master. Retained distinct green and gold spheres; excluded printed white energy bands, leaf fragments and fine glints. Large lower gold sphere remains a single disk.

smbsp-23.notes: Compared entire orange foil with clean master. Printed white spiral rays and tiny sharp energy fragments excluded; isolated orange/yellow spheres retained, including clipped left disk and complete large disk behind legs.

smbsp-24.notes: Reviewed entire blue foil, flipper gaps and all edges against clean master. Printed white waves/rays and speckled spray excluded. Restored entire upper yellow-blue disk; measured isolated background Cosmos spheres and specks retained.

smbsp-25.notes: Compared whole window with clean master. Dense flower/foliage false detections excluded. Retained isolated sky/forest disks and restored faint upper-left purple disk and large lower green disk as single features.

smbsp-26.notes: Compared full abstract background to master. Nearly all automated circles are printed petals, highlights and curved color fields; retained only distinct isolated right-edge physical specks. Reference scan is weak, unresolved faint foil features omitted.

smbsp-27.notes: Reviewed all clouds, soil and shell gaps against clean master. Removed printed cloud/stone corners; kept isolated physical foil spheres and completed large blue upper-right and pale lower-right disks.

smbsp-28.notes: Whole background compared with clean master. White lightning streaks, printed spark points and subject edges excluded. Actual isolated disks retained, largest orange upper-left disk filled intact; small interiors/satellites suppressed.
